minimax-h3.label: MiniMax H3
minimax-h3.prompt_language: English preferred for official structured prompt; preserve original-language dialog/visible text

rules.text: If composing a full H3 prompt on request, follow the official base 3-field structure with integrated_multimodal_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music. VFX selection only changes a shot's visual details and does not invent camera, music, speech or extra scenes.
rules.first-frame: Use actual Picture 1 as the existing first frame at 0.00s; attach VFX to existing object/material. Do not claim an image attachment if none was given.
rules.first-last-frame: Keep both user-supplied keyframes fixed, describe the VFX progression between them, never invent endpoint images.
rules.last-frame: Respect user's last-frame target as final image; do not fabricate first frame as provided reference.
rules.reference: Follow official subject_definitions / summary / retention_analysis / detailed_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music and source-label rules; reference only actual supplied assets.

seedance.label: Seedance
seedance.prompt_language: Natural language; preserve user language and original scene/dialogue

rules.text: Specify observable subject, cause-and-effect VFX timing and spatial/lighting response. Keep given narrative and shot boundaries unchanged.
rules.first-frame: Use the supplied first frame as character/scene/props baseline; describe only allowed VFX progression.
rules.first-last-frame: Keep actual supplied first and last reference images, state only the visible connecting VFX.
rules.reference: Bind only supplied image/video/audio references by their actual role; do not synthesize @image1 / @video1 tokens when the user has not provided or assigned references.
rules.video-edit: Change specified VFX region/interval only; preserve original identity, action, camera and audio unless explicitly allowed.
rules.extension: Continue given existing video state only when requested; preserve the prior ending state and exposure. Do not force continuity for montage cuts.
